resources.string: Review, export, or add learned words to your personal dictionary
The keyboard remembers the words you type to improve predictions. Words that are in none of its dictionaries can be added to your personal dictionary, which all keyboards and the spell checker share.
Add new words to personal dictionary

Tapping an unknown word you typed in the suggestion bar adds it right away
Add words for the language only (for example German instead of German (Switzerland)), so every variant of the language uses them
